cues.text: Hello 'Paragliders' Paradise'. How can I help you?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Oh hi. I'm interested in doing a course in paragliding.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Which course are you interested in?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, I'm not sure. What's available?
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Well ... we've got the introductory course which lasts for two days.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Or there's the 4-day beginners' course which is what most people do first. I'd tend to recommend that one. And there's also the elementary pilot course which takes five to six days depending on conditions.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: We might try the beginner's course. What sort of prices are we looking at?
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: The introductory is $190; the beginner's course, which is what you'd probably be looking at, is $320 - no, sorry 330 - it's just gone up - and the pilot course is $430.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: And you also have to become a member of our club so that you're insured. That'll cost you $12 a day. Everyone has to take out insurance, you see.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Does that cover me if I break a leg?
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: No, I'm afraid not - it's only 3rd party and covers you against damage to other people or their belongings, but not theft or injury, You would need to take out your own personal accident insurance.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I see! And what's the best way to get to your place? By public transport or could we come by bike? We're pretty keen cyclists.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: It's difficult by public transport although there is a bus from Newcastle; most people get here by car, though, 'cos we're a little off the beaten track. But you could ride here OK. I'll send you a map. Just let me take down a few details. What's your name?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Maria Gentle.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: And your address, Maria?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, I'm a student staying with a family in Newcastle.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: So it's care of ...
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Care of Mr and Mrs. McDonald.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Like the hamburgers!
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, exactly.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: McDonald ...
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: The post office box address is probably best. It's PO Box 676. Newcastle.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Is there a fax number there, because I could fax you the information?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, actually, there is. It's 0249 that's for Newcastle and then double seven five four three one.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: OK. Now if you decide to do one of our courses, you'll need to book in advance and to pay when you book. How would you be paying?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: By credit card, if that's OK. Do you take Visa?
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Yes, fine. We take all major cards, including Visa.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: OK then. Thanks very much.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Hi, PAULINE.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Hi, Maria! What's that you're reading?
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: Just some information from a paragliding school - it looks really good fun. Do you fancy a go at paragliding?
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Sure! Do you have to buy lots of equipment and stuff?
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: Not really. The school provides the equipment but we'd have to take a few things along.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Such as?
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: Well it says here. Clothes: wear stout boots, so no sneakers or sandals I suppose, and clothes suitable for an active day in the hills, preferably a long-sleeved t-shirt. That's probably in case you land in the stinging nettles! It also says we should bring a packed lunch. We do not recommend soft drinks or flasks of coffee. Water is really the best thing to drink. We'd also need to bring suntan lotion and something to protect your head from the sun!
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: OK that sounds reasonable. And where would we stay?
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: Well look! They seem to operate a campsite too, because it says here that it's only $10 a day to pitch a tent. That'd be fine, wouldn't it? And that way we'd save quite a bit because even a cheap hotel would cost money.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Urn..or perhaps we could stay in a bed and breakfast nearby. It gives a couple of names here we could ring. I think I might prefer that. Hotels and youth hostels would all be miles away from the farm and I don't fancy a caravan.
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: No, I agree. But let's take a tent and pray for good weather.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: OK - let's do it. What about next weekend?
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: No, I can't - I'm going on a geography field trip.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: ....and then it's the weekend before the exams and I really need to study.
cues.speaker: PAULINE

cues.text: OK, then. Let's make it the one after the exams.
cues.speaker: MARIA

cues.text: Fine - we'll need a break by then. Can you ring and ...
cues.speaker: PAULINE
